assistedDeskReview.by: Codex, AI-assisted documentary review; not an independent human or reader review

humanEditorialReview.scope: A responsible human checks English clarity, cultural interpretation and claim-to-source accuracy for the changed articles. AI-assisted drafting is not recorded as this review.

readerTaskCheck.scope: An actual target reader attempts to choose a culture activity, identify participation/language limits and form a practical plan; record confusion and resolve material issues. No invented participants, results or Google minimum traffic quota.

productionVerification.by: Codex: public HTTP, browser and Safari checks; not a human reader study
productionVerification.scope: After explicit deployment authorization, verify the same revision on the live domain, current event facts, links, images, selected ownership method, ads.txt and privacy/ad behavior.
